intro.text: An ancient swarm of Sleepless, the first of its kind to come to Roshar.

items.text: Twenty-three more swarms have Separated since it came to Roshar. Nineteen stay loyal to it; four, including Arclomedarian, defy it.

Yelamaiszin insisted the Wandersail's crew be driven away from Akinah. When Nikli's attempts failed, it proposed sinking the ship but was narrowly outvoted. After Rysn struck a bargain, it took part in the talks over the treaty, which was ratified.

personality.text: Calm, rational and very sure of itself, speaking with a smooth, calming buzz. It leads twenty allied swarms but leaves important decisions to a vote.
It sees humans as dangerous and in need of control, culling them if necessary, though it keeps some compassion for them, and believes Dalinar will destroy Roshar.
